meta.beschreibung: Selected nights in Darmstadt. Tickets and VIP tables straight from Lunar Events.

start.kommendLeer: Nothing announced right now. Join the list and you'll hear first.
start.markeText: We don't run events on a conveyor belt. We run a few nights a year, and they land.
start.communityText: New events, presale drops and insider news first — on Instagram and in our WhatsApp community.

events.anzahl: {anzahl, plural, =0 {No events} one {1 event} other {# events}}

event.abendkasseText: Tickets bought online guarantee entry. Door sales do not.
event.abendkasseKeine: No door sales. Tickets in advance only.
event.presaleText: With a presale code or an invitation you can buy now.
event.presaleUnbekannt: This code doesn’t unlock the presale.
event.presaleAufgebraucht: The presale tickets for this code are gone.

vip.text: With VIP you get your own table and one person who looks after you. What you want to drink and when you arrive, we sort out beforehand.

leistungen.tisch: Your own table with reserved space

vip.formText: Tell us briefly what you have in mind. We'll come back within 24 hours.
vip.name: Name
vip.nachrichtPlatzhalter: Occasion, special requests, anything that helps.
vip.gesendetText: We'll come back to you within 24 hours.
vip.emailUngueltig: That email address doesn't look right

checkout.emailHinweis: Your tickets go to this address.
checkout.agbText: I have read the <agb>terms</agb> and the <datenschutz>privacy policy</datenschutz>.
checkout.widerrufText: I understand that event tickets carry no right of withdrawal.
checkout.fehler: The payment didn't go through. Nothing was charged.
checkout.abgelaufen: Your reservation expired. Please pick your tickets again.

code.anderes_event: This code is for a different event.
code.aufgebraucht: This code has been used up.
code.passt_nicht: This code doesn’t apply to the selected tickets.
code.herausgenommen: {grund} We've removed it. Just tap Continue again.
code.kostenlosText: With your discount code this order is free. No payment needed.

checkout.werbehinweis: We’ll invite you by email to upcoming Lunar events, for example to presales. You can unsubscribe any time via the link in every email.
checkout.einladungAdresse: Your presale invitation is valid for this address.
checkout.presaleZugangFehlt: You need presale access. Go back to the event and enter your presale code.
checkout.presaleAndereAdresse: Your presale invitation only works with the address it was sent to.
checkout.wartelisteHinweis: From the waitlist · held for you until {zeit}
checkout.wartelisteAdresse: The offer is for the address you signed up with.
checkout.wartelisteVorbei: Your offer has expired. The tickets went to the next person on the list.
checkout.flaggeZustimmung: I understand: entry only from age {jahre}. Without valid ID there is no entry and no refund.
checkout.storVorbei: This event is no longer taking orders.
checkout.storPhaseZu: This ticket phase is no longer available.
checkout.storZuViele: Too many open reservations for this address or connection right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
checkout.storAllgemein: That didn’t work. Reload the page and try again.
checkout.storNichtGenug: “{phase}” has sold out in the meantime. Available: {rest}.
checkout.storVorkasseKnapp: It’s too close to this event for a bank transfer. Please choose another payment method.
checkout.storVorkasseAbgelaufen: Your reservation has expired. Please choose your tickets again.
checkout.fastlaneRaus: Fast Lane just sold out. We’ve removed it — just tap Continue again.
checkout.ticketsFuerEvent: {anzahl, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} for {event}.
checkout.fastlaneEinzeiler: your own lane at the door, no queue.
checkout.ppNichtVorbereitet: The payment could not be prepared.
checkout.ppTicketsFehlen: The payment went through, but the tickets are still missing. Please get in touch with your order number and we’ll issue them right away.

bestaetigung.mailHinweis: Your tickets are on their way to {email}. Nothing there? Check spam or get in touch.
bestaetigung.walletHinweis: Add the tickets to your wallet and they're ready at the door.
bestaetigung.mailFehltNoch: Email delivery isn't set up yet. This page is the only place your tickets exist right now, so take a screenshot or keep the tab open.

ticket.keine: Nothing here yet. Buy a ticket and it lands here.
ticket.scanHinweis: Show this at the door. Turn your brightness up.
ticket.gastEntfernt: This entry is no longer on the guest list. Get in touch if that’s a mistake.
ticket.gastWarnungTitel: Anyone with this link gets in.
ticket.gastWarnung: Each code is for one person and works exactly once. Your plus-one can show their code from your phone. No phone? No problem: you’re on the list by name.
ticket.abgesagtBanner: This event has been cancelled. The ticket price will be refunded. If nothing has arrived after two weeks, get in touch.
ticket.linkWarnungTitel: Whoever has this link gets in.
ticket.linkWarnungText: Each code can be redeemed exactly once. Only share this link with people you trust, and never post it publicly.

konto.anmeldenText: We'll email you a link. No password needed.
konto.linkGesendet: The link is on its way. Check your inbox.
konto.teamText: Events, orders, VIP requests and payments. This account belongs to the team.
konto.anmeldelinkAbgelaufen: The sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
konto.anmeldelinkUnvollstaendig: The sign-in link was incomplete. Request a new one.
konto.anmeldeZuOft: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
konto.anmeldeKeinTeam: This account has no backoffice access.
konto.anmeldeFehler: That didn’t work. Please try again.
konto.anmeldeEmail: This email address is not valid.
konto.mitLink: No password? Send a sign-in link by email

footer.newsletterText: A few mails a year, only when there's something to say.
footer.newsletterDanke: Almost there. Click the confirmation link in your email.

allgemein.fehlerText: Please try again. If it keeps happening, write to us.
allgemein.nichtGefundenText: The link may be old. Here are the events.

promoter.intro: This is what’s happening through your links. The numbers are always up to date.
promoter.pausiert: Your link is paused right now. Clicks and purchases don't count at the moment.
promoter.linksText: Share the link for each event. It counts when someone comes through it and buys right away.
promoter.mitCode: Your code {code} is already in the link: {rabatt} off per ticket.
promoter.keineEvents: No event is on sale right now. Your link will show up here as soon as tickets are available.
promoter.keineZahlen: No numbers yet. As soon as someone opens your link, you’ll see it here.
promoter.hinweis: Clicks are page views, not people: opening twice counts twice. Tickets count once they’re paid.
promoter.geheim: This link is just for you. Anyone who has it can see your numbers.

werbung.text: We invite you by email to upcoming Lunar events, for example to presales. One click and you won’t hear about them anymore. Your tickets and ticket emails are not affected.
werbung.erledigt: Done. You won’t receive any more invitations from us.
werbung.fehler: That didn’t work. Drop us a line at kontakt@lunar-events.de and we’ll remove you by hand.

warteliste.text: Join the waitlist. If tickets free up, we’ll email you and you’ll have {stunden} hours to buy.
warteliste.hinweis: We’ll send you a link to confirm. We only use your address for this waitlist.
warteliste.mailUnterwegs: Almost done. Confirm via the link we sent to {email}.
warteliste.schonDrauf: {email} is already on the waitlist. We’ll be in touch as soon as something frees up.
warteliste.fehlerEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
warteliste.fehlerNichtAusverkauft: Tickets are available again. Please reload the page.
warteliste.fehlerVersand: That didn’t work. Please try again in a moment.
warteliste.fehlerEventZu: There’s no waitlist for this event anymore.
warteliste.unbestaetigtText: Confirm that you want to join the waitlist for {event} for {anzahl, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}.
warteliste.wartetText: {anzahl, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} for {event}. If something frees up, we'll email {email}. You'll then have {stunden} hours to buy, and at night at least until 10 am.
warteliste.reihenfolge: It's first come, first served. If your number of tickets doesn't fit what's free, the next person gets it. You still stay at the front.
warteliste.austragenFrage: Leave the waitlist? You’ll lose your place.
warteliste.ausgetragenText: You’re no longer on the waitlist for {event}.
warteliste.angebotText: {anzahl, plural, one {# ticket is} other {# tickets are}} held for you for {event} until {zeit}. After that they go to the next person on the list.
warteliste.freigebenFrage: Release the tickets? They’ll go straight to the next person on the list.
warteliste.ueberweisungText: Your tickets appear once the payment has arrived. The bank details are with your order.
warteliste.verfallenText: The tickets went to the next person on the list. If {event} is still sold out, you can sign up again, at the back of the list.
warteliste.fehler: That didn’t work. Reload the page and try again.

tuer.text: Order {nummer}. Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Once it's through, the door will let you in.
tuer.zustimmung: I have read the <agb>terms</agb> and the <datenschutz>privacy policy</datenschutz>. There is no right of withdrawal for event tickets.
tuer.bezahltText: Thanks! Show this page at the door. You're already marked as paid there.
tuer.abgelaufenText: This payment has expired or was cancelled. Ask at the door for a new code.
tuer.keineKarte: Card payment isn’t set up right now. Please pay cash at the door.

garderobe.kasseText: Drop off a jacket or bag, {preis} per item. Instead of a paper tag you get a QR code.
garderobe.name: Cloakroom
garderobe.vergriffen: The cloakroom just filled up. We removed it, just tap Continue again.
garderobe.nachbuchenText: {preis} per item, at most two per ticket. Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
garderobe.nachbuchenZustimmung: I have read the <agb>terms</agb> and the <datenschutz>privacy policy</datenschutz>. There is no right of withdrawal for services tied to a fixed event date.
garderobe.nachbuchenMenge: That's the maximum for this order: two items per ticket.
garderobe.nachbuchenZu: The cloakroom can no longer be booked for this event.
garderobe.nachbuchenFehler: That didn't work. Please try again.

ticketVip.warnungTitel: Whoever has this link gets in.
ticketVip.warnung: Each ticket is for the person named on it and works exactly once. Every ticket has its own link below it. Send it to that person and they have their ticket themselves.
ticketVip.storniert: This booking was cancelled. Get in touch if that's a mistake.
ticketVip.warnungEinzeln: Your ticket works exactly once. No phone? No problem, your name is on the list.

newsletter.bestaetigenText: One more click and you’re in.
newsletter.abmeldenText: You won’t get any more newsletter emails from us.
newsletter.abmeldenErledigt: Done. We won’t send you the newsletter anymore.
newsletter.fehler: This link is no longer valid.

fastlane.standardtext: Your own lane at the door: skip the queue and walk straight in.
fastlane.fuerTickets: Fast Lane {anzahl, plural, one {for my ticket} other {for all # tickets}}
fastlane.restKnapp: {rest, plural, one {# Fast Lane spot left.} other {# Fast Lane spots left.}}

ueberweisung.verwendungHinweis: Use only {nummer} as the reference. Otherwise we can’t match the payment to your order.
ueberweisung.fristHinweis: Your spots are reserved until {frist}. If payment doesn’t arrive by then, they’ll be released.
ueberweisung.ticketsHinweis: Your tickets appear at your ticket link once payment has arrived, usually within one or two business days.
